lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਜਨ ਕਉਨੁ ਤੁਮਾਰੈ ਆਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: raajan kaun tumaarai aavai ||
lines.translation: O king, who will come to you?

lines.gurmukhi: ਐਸੋ ਭਾਉ ਬਿਦਰ ਕੋ ਦੇਖਿਓ ਓਹੁ ਗਰੀਬੁ ਮੋਹਿ ਭਾਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: aiso bhaau bidar ko dekhio ohu gareeb mohi bhaavai ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: I have seen such love from Bidur, that the poor man is pleasing to me. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਸਤੀ ਦੇਖਿ ਭਰਮ ਤੇ ਭੂਲਾ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਭਗਵਾਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: hasatee dekh bharam te bhoolaa sree bhagavaan na jaaniaa ||
lines.translation: Gazing upon your elephants, you have gone astray in doubt; you do not know the Great Lord God.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੁਮਰੋ ਦੂਧੁ ਬਿਦਰ ਕੋ ਪਾਨੑੋ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਕਰਿ ਮੈ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: tumaro doodh bidar ko paanho a(n)mrit kar mai maaniaa ||1||
lines.translation: I judge Bidur's water to be like ambrosial nectar, in comparison with your milk. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਖੀਰ ਸਮਾਨਿ ਸਾਗੁ ਮੈ ਪਾਇਆ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਤ ਰੈਨਿ ਬਿਹਾਨੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: kheer samaan saag mai paaiaa gun gaavat rain bihaanee ||
lines.translation: I find his rough vegetables to be like rice pudding; the night of my life passes singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਕੋ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਅਨਦ ਬਿਨੋਦੀ ਜਾਤਿ ਨ ਕਾਹੂ ਕੀ ਮਾਨੀ ॥੨॥੯॥
lines.transliteration: kabeer ko thaakur anad binodee jaat na kaahoo kee maanee ||2||9||
lines.translation: Kabeer's Lord and Master is joyous and blissful; He does not care about anyone's social class. ||2||9||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਕਬੀਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok kabeer ||
lines.translation: Salok, Kabeer:

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਗਨ ਦਮਾਮਾ ਬਾਜਿਓ ਪਰਿਓ ਨੀਸਾਨੈ ਘਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: gagan damaamaa baajio pario neesaanai ghaau ||
lines.translation: The battle-drum beats in the sky of the mind; aim is taken, and the wound is inflicted.

lines.gurmukhi: ਖੇਤੁ ਜੁ ਮਾਂਡਿਓ ਸੂਰਮਾ ਅਬ ਜੂਝਨ ਕੋ ਦਾਉ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: khet j maa(n)dio sooramaa ab joojhan ko daau ||1||
lines.translation: The spiritual warriors enter the field of battle; now is the time to fight! ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੂਰਾ ਸੋ ਪਹਿਚਾਨੀਐ ਜੁ ਲਰੈ ਦੀਨ ਕੇ ਹੇਤ ॥
lines.transliteration: sooraa so pahichaaneeai j larai deen ke het ||
lines.translation: He alone is known as a spiritual hero, who fights in defense of religion.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੁਰਜਾ ਪੁਰਜਾ ਕਟਿ ਮਰੈ ਕਬਹੂ ਨ ਛਾਡੈ ਖੇਤੁ ॥੨॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: purajaa purajaa kat marai kabahoo na chhaadai khet ||2||2||
lines.translation: He may be cut apart, piece by piece, but he never leaves the field of battle. ||2||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਰਾਗੁ ਮਾਰੂ ਬਾਣੀ ਨਾਮਦੇਉ ਜੀ ਕੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: kabeer kaa sabad raag maaroo baanee naamadeu jee kee ||
lines.translation: Shabad Of Kabeer, Raag Maaroo, The Word Of Naam Dayv Jee:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਾਰਿ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਚਾਰੈ ਸਿਧਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਕੈ ਦੂਲਹ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਸਰਨਿ ਪਰਿਓ ॥
lines.transliteration: chaar mukat chaarai sidh mil kai doolah prabh kee saran pario ||
lines.translation: I have obtained the four kinds of liberation, and the four miraculous spiritual powers, in the Sanctuary of God, my Husband Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੁਕਤਿ ਭਇਓ ਚਉਹੂੰ ਜੁਗ ਜਾਨਿਓ ਜਸੁ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਮਾਥੈ ਛਤ੍ਰੁ ਧਰਿਓ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: mukat bhaio chauhoo(n) jug jaanio jas keerat maathai chhatr dhario ||1||
lines.translation: I am liberated, and famous throughout the four ages; the canopy of praise and fame waves over my head. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਜਾ ਰਾਮ ਜਪਤ ਕੋ ਕੋ ਨ ਤਰਿਓ ॥
lines.transliteration: raajaa raam japat ko ko na tario ||
lines.translation: Meditating on the Sovereign Lord God, who has not been saved?

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਉਪਦੇਸਿ ਸਾਧ ਕੀ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਭਗਤੁ ਭਗਤੁ ਤਾ ਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਰਿਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur upades saadh kee sa(n)gat bhagat bhagat taa ko naam pario ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Whoever follows the Guru's Teachings and joins the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, is called the most devoted of the devotees. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਖ ਚਕ੍ਰ ਮਾਲਾ ਤਿਲਕੁ ਬਿਰਾਜਿਤ ਦੇਖਿ ਪ੍ਰਤਾਪੁ ਜਮੁ ਡਰਿਓ ॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)kh chakr maalaa tilak biraajit dekh prataap jam dario ||
lines.translation: He is adorned with the conch, the chakra, the mala and the ceremonial tilak mark on his forehead; gazing upon his radiant glory, the Messenger of Death is scared away.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਭਉ ਭਏ ਰਾਮ ਬਲ ਗਰਜਿਤ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਸੰਤਾਪ ਹਿਰਿਓ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: nirabhau bhae raam bal garajit janam maran sa(n)taap hirio ||2||
lines.translation: He becomes fearless, and the power of the Lord thunders through him; the pains of birth and death are taken away. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਬਰੀਕ ਕਉ ਦੀਓ ਅਭੈ ਪਦੁ ਰਾਜੁ ਭਭੀਖਨ ਅਧਿਕ ਕਰਿਓ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)bareek kau deeo abhai pad raaj bhabheekhan adhik kario ||
lines.translation: The Lord blessed Ambreek with fearless dignity, and elevated Bhabhikhan to become king.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਠਾਕੁਰਿ ਦਈ ਸੁਦਾਮੈ ਧ੍ਰੂਅ ਅਟਲੁ ਅਜਹੂ ਨ ਟਰਿਓ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: nau nidh thaakur daee sudaamai dhroo atal ajahoo na tario ||3||
lines.translation: Sudama's Lord and Master blessed him with the nine treasures; he made Dhroo permanent and unmoving; as the north star, he still hasn't moved. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਗਤ ਹੇਤਿ ਮਾਰਿਓ ਹਰਨਾਖਸੁ ਨਰਸਿੰਘ ਰੂਪ ਹੋਇ ਦੇਹ ਧਰਿਓ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhagat het maario haranaakhas narasi(n)gh roop hoi deh dhario ||
lines.translation: For the sake of His devotee Prahlaad, God assumed the form of the man-lion, and killed Harnaakhash.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮਾ ਕਹੈ ਭਗਤਿ ਬਸਿ ਕੇਸਵ ਅਜਹੂੰ ਬਲਿ ਕੇ ਦੁਆਰ ਖਰੋ ॥੪॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naamaa kahai bhagat bas kesav ajahoo(n) bal ke duaar kharo ||4||1||
lines.translation: Says Naam Dayv, the beautiful-haired Lord is in the power of His devotees; He is standing at Balraja's door, even now! ||4||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: maaroo kabeer jeeu ||
lines.translation: Maaroo, Kabeer Jee:

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੀਨੁ ਬਿਸਾਰਿਓ ਰੇ ਦਿਵਾਨੇ ਦੀਨੁ ਬਿਸਾਰਿਓ ਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: deen bisaario re divaane deen bisaario re ||
lines.translation: You have forgotten your religion, O madman; you have forgotten your religion.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੇਟੁ ਭਰਿਓ ਪਸੂਆ ਜਿਉ ਸੋਇਓ ਮਨੁਖੁ ਜਨਮੁ ਹੈ ਹਾਰਿਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: pet bhario pasooaa jiu soio manukh janam hai haario ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: You fill your belly, and sleep like an animal; you have wasted and lost this human life. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਕਬਹੂ ਨਹੀ ਕੀਨੀ ਰਚਿਓ ਧੰਧੈ ਝੂਠ ॥
lines.transliteration: saadhasa(n)gat kabahoo nahee keenee rachio dha(n)dhai jhooth ||
lines.translation: You never joined the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. You are engrossed in false pursuits.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਆਨ ਸੂਕਰ ਬਾਇਸ ਜਿਵੈ ਭਟਕਤੁ ਚਾਲਿਓ ਊਠਿ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: suaan sookar baais jivai bhatakat chaalio ooth ||1||
lines.translation: You wander like a dog, a pig, a crow; soon, you shall have to get up and leave. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪਸ ਕਉ ਦੀਰਘੁ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਨੈ ਅਉਰਨ ਕਉ ਲਗ ਮਾਤ ॥
lines.transliteration: aapas kau deeragh kar jaanai auran kau lag maat ||
lines.translation: You believe that you yourself are great, and that others are small.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਸਾ ਬਾਚਾ ਕਰਮਨਾ ਮੈ ਦੇਖੇ ਦੋਜਕ ਜਾਤ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: manasaa baachaa karamanaa mai dekhe dojak jaat ||2||
lines.translation: Those who are false in thought, word and deed, I have seen them going to hell. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਮੀ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੀ ਚਾਤੁਰੀ ਬਾਜੀਗਰ ਬੇਕਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaamee krodhee chaaturee baajeegar bekaam ||
lines.translation: The lustful, the angry, the clever, the deceitful and the lazy

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿੰਦਾ ਕਰਤੇ ਜਨਮੁ ਸਿਰਾਨੋ ਕਬਹੂ ਨ ਸਿਮਰਿਓ ਰਾਮੁ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: ni(n)daa karate janam siraano kabahoo na simario raam ||3||
lines.translation: waste their lives in slander, and never remember their Lord in meditation. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਚੇਤੈ ਨਹੀ ਮੂਰਖੁ ਮੁਗਧੁ ਗਵਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: kahi kabeer chetai nahee moorakh mugadh gavaar ||
lines.translation: Says Kabeer, the fools, the idiots and the brutes do not remember the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਮੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਾਨਿਓ ਨਹੀ ਕੈਸੇ ਉਤਰਸਿ ਪਾਰਿ ॥੪॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: raam naam jaanio nahee kaise utaras paar ||4||1||
lines.translation: They do not know the Lord's Name; how can they be carried across? ||4||1||
